summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repo without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member to ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL formatter and Control.title(title); rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title), which writes the control and returns True only when is_terminal, else False; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only via the module skip), and test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (forced terminal, skipped on win32). Added lines were checked for length against the 88-character limit by reading the diff only; Black was not run. One stray no-op edit attempt made no change.
